author: __Trojan
body:
So I left this server for a couple of months because it really just wasn't fun anymore, while I was gone I had an idea for Nebula.
(Sorry if I ramble)
So we should do something like the NFL where there are a bunch of teams and every team has their own mascot, logo, etc, and there are different championships or cups every few months or maybe every year. We could have commentary, referees and we could record these games (not live stream because then the teams could cheat and watch other teams perspective while playing) and we dont have to have one hard camera we can have one guy going to everyones POV and recording from there, also for the commentary they should analyze the teams strategy, strengths and weaknesses, etc. 

To rank the teams we could go one of two ways (or both if we change up the system):

1) We could use the English Football system and have multiple leagues and we could have either ladders or tournament brackets to crown the winner of each league, in the bottom league any team can join but only the winning team gets into the next league and the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th, and 7th teams have a tournament and the winning team also advances to the next league, this cycle continues up the leagues until the final league where just the winning team wins and they rewards.  PROS: This is more inclusive of teams as everyone gets to play CONS: This might be confusing for viewers because they have all this content thrown at them and they'll find it hard to pick which ones they want to watch.

2) Alternatively, we could use the American Football method of just having big set teams and they have playoffs every season and theres a huge final game at the end of every season (that might not be how American football works I'm not American but that's how it works as far as I know).

PROS: It's a lot smoother for the viewers as it's just 1 league CONS: Players can't create their own teams after the intial teams have been created and they would be forced to try out for teams or join teams however it ends up working

So that's my idea! The point of this is to get publicity within the gaming community and maybe within the E-Sports community, this could get more players in Avicus as fans of our content can easily join our leagues without having to be fit or anything. What do you guys think? Is it terrible or is it great? Do you have any major or minor tweaks? I'm completely open to feedback so please give it to me! Thanks for your time!

replies.body:
The idea of the league would work so well if there were more teams. Each team is randomly sorted into the certain number of leagues. You play for lik a month or something, the top 2 or 3 teams get promoted and the bottom 2 or 3 teams are relegated.

You could also then do world cup type things with different teams constructed determined by countries or continents?
